profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at EOG Resources
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer offering 10 years leading cross-functional teams and completing projects on-time. Seamlessly manages workload to meet deadlines.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Assisted in developing the initial specifications for applications to help mobile sales forces remain in touch with their corporate offices.
Part of a team that was tasked with developing three applications per year that were sold to the general public.
Often asked to accompany company sales professionals to client meetings to answer technical questions.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Co-developed a dynamic, secure Web site from scratch. Launched visually appealing, user-friendly Webscape with interactive features to optimize traffic, page views, site "stickiness" and user experience (UX).
Used SEO best practices to elevate organization's Web presence.
Created online surveys, contests and donation forms that boosted funding and organizational visibility. Helped drive $38K in ecommerce revenues.

positions.title: Petroleum Supply Specialist
positions.description:
Performed daily preventive maintenance checks on 13 Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Trucks (HEMTT) and various military diesel vehicles; analyzing the levels of petroleum, Aqua glow, and Mila Pour by recirculation of fuel.
Conducted monthly inspections and reports for petroleum based products for testing.
Administered fuel to aircraft aviation helicopters, stationery equipment, and military vehicles while maintaining, gauging, annotating, and accounting for mass accounts of JP8 (POL).
Trained new team members the safety standard procedures for handling petroleum through proper protective equipment (PPE), inspecting of hazmat equipment, and ensured overall appropriate emergency precautions to prevent harm.
Capable of driving the M978 fueling truck for the various locations oversees as well as state side.
Received and transported POL bulk with proper identification marking and documentation on containers.

positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
Planned new Internet marketing strategies – Provided leadership and guidance to search-engine marketers.
Developed ways to significantly improve web content, create on-page and off-page optimization, website design and technical adaptation.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
Maintained local phone connectivity and hookups.
Support and maintained local servers.
Establish and maintain external communication with other networks.
Operate and maintain corporate network and critical networks, protecting network assets. 
Ensure daily activities are aligned with Network Operation Division priorities and objectives.
